physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Omega Centauri is recorded: it is an extended globular cluster, and its package frames it at 43.4 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: ESO/INAF-VST/OmegaCAM eso1119b native TIFF and embedded AVM. The common observation-frame center is an adopted registration origin, not a new dynamical centroid measurement. (https://cdn.eso.org/images/original/eso1119b.tif); catalogue reference eso1119b-frame
sources.distance: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, Table 2, NGC 5139: combined distance 5.426 +/- 0.047 kpc. Full downloaded paper bytes. (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2105.09526); catalogue reference baumgardt-vasiliev-2021: 5426 pc (-47/+47); Combined Gaia EDR3, HST and literature distance, Table 2, NGC 5139. One cluster scale; individual stellar distances are not recovered.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the globular cluster is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
